provenanceNotes: Per-run reports preserve source and bundle hashes at execution, immutable upstream URLs/served byte hashes and browser force-cache dependency rereads. Final runtime and contract cases match their tested hashes. Later test-only changes added pixel evidence/reporting and an environment topology assertion; those selections were rerun as recorded.
Raw report capture paths refer to ignored test-results. The applications and artifacts arrays identify the preserved copies under docs/validation/issue-55.
The Firefox official release DMG and geckodriver tar archive were downloaded for this worktree; no application, extension feature request, geometry or result was substituted.

failuresAndCorrections.failure: Cumulative deformation assertion did not advance for selected face under X-only scaling.
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Apply uniform scaling with step sized to 2e-6 m per maximum local coordinate; 30 individually subthreshold steps exceed the retained published baseline.

failuresAndCorrections.failure: 4846 real callbacks and 100 detected meshes, but no observed scene: selector looked for plane Sample RingGeometry.
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Use the unchanged mesh Sample SphereGeometry to find its scene.

failuresAndCorrections.check: binding implementation inspection against pinned WebIDL
failuresAndCorrections.failure: Initial readonly membership wrapper returned Array iterators.
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Private Set storage with frozen readers now supplies genuine Set iterators; focused tests assert the prototype.

interpretation.originalAssumption: Comparing shape to the preceding frame suffices while republishing geometry every frame.
interpretation.correction: Compare with published geometry and publish changed shape and notification coherently, including cumulative subthreshold changes.
interpretation.rationale: The mesh attribute-change prose excludes pose-only timestamps despite its unconditional algorithm. The unchanged Sample rebuilds retained geometry only when lastChangedTime advances. Plane timestamp WPT corroborates only planes, not mesh behavior.
interpretation.externalIssueOrPRUpdates: Not performed: node explicitly prohibits comments, PRs and pushes. Reconciliation retained in committed documentation for downstream use.
